items.difficulty_reason: For a taut continuous homomorphism of linearly topologized rings with weakly pre-adic source, the lemma asserts that the target is weakly pre-adic (statement lines 1740-1745). The proof exhibits the ideal that witnesses the property: an ideal I of A whose power closures I_n are open and form a fundamental system is chosen, the closure of I^n B is identified with the closure of I_n B, and tautness then says these closures are open and form a fundamental system of open ideals of B, which is exactly weak pre-adicity (proof lines 1747-1752). The level is H2: the comparison of the two closures is the point, and it is stated, with the rest read off from the definition.
